neighbours.label: internet standards documents: the tokens RFC and IETF naming the source of a protocol specification
fire: HTTP status codes are listed in RFC 7231, section 6.
Email address syntax follows RFC 5322 in most mail servers.
A working group at the IETF proposed the new transport protocol.
According to the IETF, the draft will expire after six months.
Keywords such as SHOULD are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.
TLS 1.3 was standardized by the IETF and published as RFC 8446.
Port numbers are assigned by IANA, as documented in RFC 6335.
quiet: HTTP status codes are shown in the browser console, on the left.
Email address books sync with most mail servers overnight.
A working group at the university proposed the new transport plan.
According to the ministry, the permit will expire after six months.
Keywords such as SHOULD are to be highlighted in bold in the manual.
Paper sizes were standardized by ISO and published as ISO 216.
Seat numbers are assigned by the airline, as shown on the ticket.
